items.text: Las Vegas (final): OUT - DT Tonka Hemingway (stinger). QUESTIONABLE - TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad, limited Thu/Fri, game-time call), K Matt Gay (hip), DT Folorunso Fatukasi (toe). IR - DE Patrick Johnson. Fernando Mendoza starts.

Denver (final): OUT - TE Caleb Lohner (foot). QUESTIONABLE - S Brandon Jones (hamstring). S Talanoa Hufanga, CB Riley Moss, WR Jaylen Waddle no designation. IR - RB RJ Harvey, LB Jonah Elliss. Bo Nix starts.
